abilities.name: Shimmer Spin - EoT
lines: When Shimmer Spin skill was used and according to the most-used element type in current turn:
* If Null: Magic attack on all enemies (XL) and restore all party members' HP +50%
* If Fire/Earth/Wind/Water: Fire/Earth/Wind/Water type magic attack on all enemies (XL) and Fire/Earth/Wind/Water type resistance of all enemies -100% (1 turn), respectively
* Damage is based on user's PWR
* Most used element:
** Multi-move skill like Copy counts twice.
** HP and MP healing and self-damage count as Null.
** fixed damage/counters/EoT attacks/additional attack from 1 More or other elements attacks are not counted.
** if a skill has multiple elements, each count.
** if an attack also has healing, only count the attack
** random from few elements if they are tied as most used.
